This application includes source code extracted from Petrobras GeoSlicer.
Upstream repository: https://github.com/petrobras/GeoSlicer
Commit: c849620433dc36fd1c78cc93f0aa33c32e5b8f54
Source file: src/modules/Segmenter/BayesianInferenceCLI/BayesianInferenceCLI.py
Extracted functions: create_stencil_mask, bayesian_inference.
Upstream license: Apache License, Version 2.0 (included as LICENSE-GeoSlicer.txt).
Original function bodies have been retained. Imports and calling interface
have been separated from Slicer/VTK and limited to the supported 2D path.
The Chinese GUI, tiling wrapper, project reference parameters, color and
edge rules, uncertainty overlays, and report exporter are local additions.
No official GeoSlicer pretrained weights are included.
